requirements.text: "Narco government" written in graffiti on the barricades surrounding the National Palace
requirements.requirement: Preserve Narco government as written graffiti content, OCR scope, and the barricades/National Palace location. Do not assert a narco government exists as an unqualified world fact.

requirements.text: Multiple aerial footage clips around the Hilton as it smokes.
requirements.requirement: Preserve multiple aerial clips, Hilton, smoke and the depicted footage/source relationship. Do not drop aerial or the source scope.

requirements.text: Angupaul1 is relying on a portable charger to livestream.
requirements.requirement: Angupaul1 relies on a portable charger for the purpose of livestreaming. The purpose must not become an independent assertion that livestreaming occurs.

requirements.text: Notice that the clouds take on a more eastward motion in an anti-cyclonic swirl.
requirements.requirement: Clouds have more eastward motion in an anti-cyclonic swirl. Notice is a discourse instruction; the descriptive content must remain. A refusal is preferable to a changed event.

requirements.text: Timelapse of incoming massive dust storm.
requirements.requirement: The timelapse depicts an incoming massive dust storm. Preserve source, approach and size; the nominal fragment does not supply an absolute event time.

requirements.text: Tent says covid 19 vaccine victims
requirements.requirement: The tent carries written covid 19 vaccine victims text. Use OCR content, not a speaking-tent interpretation; 19 belongs to the name rather than a group count.

requirements.text: Thousands of people are rallying and protesting in Mexico.
requirements.requirement: Preserve thousands of people, rallying, protesting and Mexico, with the same participants. Explicit refusal is acceptable while quantified groups are unsupported.

requirements.text: Police arrive with detained students inside van.
requirements.requirement: Police arrive with detained students inside a van. Preserve accompaniment, detention state and location without inventing who detained the students.

requirements.text: People wearing full white clothing are walking between the tents.
requirements.requirement: People in full white clothing walk between tents. The same people wear and walk; white modifies clothing; between relates the walking/people to tents.

requirements.text: National rally protesters chanting "will never be defeated".
requirements.requirement: National rally protesters chant the quoted future-negative slogan. The quotation is speech content; never must not negate the chanting event or assert the slogan as world truth.

requirements.text: A car is parked on the grass in a park.
requirements.requirement: A car is in a parked state on grass in a park. Do not invent a parking agent or require that a parking maneuver is currently occurring.

requirements.text: Heavy fog makes it difficult to see.
requirements.requirement: Heavy fog makes seeing difficult. Do not independently assert that seeing occurs; difficulty is not successful perception.

requirements.text: Fireworks in the distance.
requirements.requirement: Fireworks are in the distance. This nominal fragment can state existence/location without inventing a named actor or exact time.

requirements.text: Massive dust storm is closing in.
requirements.requirement: A massive dust storm is approaching. Preserve size and progressive aspect; closing in is the approach reading.

requirements.text: Arizona dust storm.
requirements.requirement: Preserve an Arizona dust storm, including Arizona and dust; the fragment has no explicit finite tense.

requirements.text: Celebratory fireworks over river.
requirements.requirement: Preserve celebratory fireworks over a river. Retain the celebratory qualifier and spatial relation; do not require a separate observed celebration event.

requirements.text: Rocket is launched successfully.
requirements.requirement: A rocket is launched successfully. The rocket is the launch participant, not a named agent; preserve success and the passive auxiliary sequence.

requirements.text: The tent has an air conditioning unit.
requirements.requirement: The tent has an air-conditioning unit. Preserve the tent/unit relationship and the unit type.

requirements.text: Akiak, Alaska has not had electricity for 22 days and counting due to Typhoon Halong.
requirements.requirement: Akiak, Alaska has lacked electricity for 22 days and counting because of Typhoon Halong. Preserve negation, duration and cause; refusal is acceptable while this scope/duration is unsupported.

requirements.text: Power services is working in home.
requirements.requirement: Power services is working in home is ambiguous about subject and location. Preserve the wording or refuse; do not certify a particular company/household interpretation without context.
